articles.summary: Integrating an IP block into a system-on-chip can open new paths for sensitive data, including cryptographic keys. This article explains how chip and IP teams can use information-flow analysis to check where that data travels. By documenting which paths they tested, what they found and where coverage gaps remain, suppliers can help manufacturers assess cybersecurity risks and prepare technical documentation for the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
articles.title: EDN: Preparing for the EU CRA with hardware security verification

articles.summary: Code reviews require engineers to assess implementations alongside specifications, tickets and test results to identify gaps that could affect release readiness. This article explores how multiple AI agents can bring that evidence together, flag potential issues and organize follow-up actions — while leaving engineers responsible for validating findings and deciding how to address them.
articles.title: How to Use AI Agents to Streamline Code Reviews
